title: Deductible Rewards Claim-Free-Year Credit Entry: Desk Systems Reference for Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage
content:
**Subject.** The claim-free credit is the Deductible Rewards credit a vehicle enrolled in Deductible Rewards earns under Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage for a completed claim-free year. Each completed claim-free year earns one claim-free-year credit entry on the vehicle's coverage, and the credit granted raises the vehicle's Deductible Rewards credit balance. Credit is never paid in cash.

## Business effect of a grant

| Before the grant | After the grant |
|---|---|
| The coverage's credit entries end with the latest credit already granted | One more credit entry, reason claim-free year, dated today, for the claim-free year ending on the date given |
| Deductible Rewards credit balance | Raised by the amount granted; the customer sees the new balance on the coverage |

## The grant tool

**Tool:** `grant_claim_free_credit_c23d8d33`

**Capability.** Grants a Deductible Rewards credit to one vehicle's physical damage coverage for a completed claim-free year. One call adds one claim-free-year credit entry and raises the coverage's credit balance by the amount granted.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool. The agent unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and then calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `coverage_id` | The reference number of the vehicle's physical damage coverage, read from the customer's coverage records | Text identifier |
| `credit_period_end` | The last day of the claim-free year being credited | YYYY-MM-DD |
| `amount` | The credit granted | USD, 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent |

**Return.** A receipt with `credit_id` (reference of the credit entry), `coverage_id`, `credit_reason` (always `claim_free_year`), `credit_period_end` (YYYY-MM-DD), `amount` (USD to 2 decimal places), `new_balance` (the coverage's Deductible Rewards balance after the grant, USD to 2 decimal places) and `granted_on` (today's date, YYYY-MM-DD). A receipt carrying `credit_id` means the credit was granted.

*Hypothetical illustration of the receipt shape:* a grant of 100.00 for a year ending 2026-04-10 on a coverage whose balance was 150.00 returns `new_balance` 250.0 and `credit_reason` claim_free_year.
